Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a premium architectural competition visualization for a web concept gallery, one image only
Scene/backdrop: a speculative site in Portland Oregon Central Eastside, coherent low-rise early twentieth century brick warehouses on an industrial urban block, Pacific Northwest street trees, broad wet pavement and subtly reflective sidewalk, no recognizable landmark claimed.
Subject and constant geometry: a credible new data center approximately 84 meters long, 44 meters deep, 16 meters tall, two main levels, long primary frontage.
Style/medium: exceptional photorealistic architectural competition CGI, physically plausible construction joints and rich tactile materials, exquisite detailing, composed by an architectural photographer, precise and elegant.
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape. Consistent slightly elevated three-quarter frontal viewpoint from across the street, camera about 7m above ground looking at the long frontage and right end, 32mm architectural lens with corrected verticals. Building fills most of the frame, entire architectural silhouette visible, enough context to establish street and scale. Small unobtrusive pedestrians for scale, restrained street furniture.
Lighting/mood: luminous overcast northwest daylight after rain, soft directional highlights, layered gray sky, restrained and believable saturation.
Constraints: schematic enclosed rooftop plant screens and discreet rear service courts suited to data center function; avoid any environmental performance claims. No text, no labels, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Not a collage or multi-panel image. Conceptual rendering, not verified site photography.
Primary request: KILN & CANOPY, the standout approved architectural concept. A long deeply articulated warm reddish recycled-brick facade of substantial rhythmic vertical piers and narrow brick ribs; each bay possesses carefully proportioned shadow depth and exquisitely realistic varied brick bond. Dark recessed glazing along the base and discreet dark ventilation integrated in upper bays. Strong crisp dark flat roof and parapet, a projecting weathered copper entrance canopy with a slim folded edge clearly marking the main entrance. Select terracotta fins, low planted roof strips behind parapets, generous meadow rain gardens edging the public pavement. The architecture feels lasting, sophisticated, monumental yet neighborly, with the precision and atmosphere of a winning contemporary architecture competition. Keep the primary mass unified and two stories tall, with a beautifully proportioned entry setback.
